## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🎯 Use Case
Describe the problem your feature would solve or the value it would add. Who would benefit from this feature?

## 📝 Proposed Implementation
If you have ideas on how this feature could be implemented, describe them here:
- [ ] Possible approach 1
- [ ] Possible approach 2

## 🔄 Alternatives
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📚 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.

## ⚡ Priority
- [ ] Low - Nice to have
- [ ] Medium - Would be useful
- [ ] High - Important for workflow
